        "contents": "        }\n    }\n    \n    private func nearbyDevices(around deviceID: String, coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D, thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [KnownDevice] {\n        let targetLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n        let devicesWithCoordinates: [(KnownDevice, CLLocationCoordinate2D)] = deviceStore.devices.compactMap { known in\n            if let cached = cachedDeviceCoordinates[known.DeviceID] {\n                return (known, cached)\n            }\n            guard let coord = deviceCoordinate(for: known.DeviceID) else { return nil }\n            return (known, coord)\n        }\n        \n        let closeDevices = devicesWithCoordinates.filter { pair in\n            let loc = CLLocation(latitude: pair.1.latitude, longitude: pair.1.longitude)\n            return targetLocation.distance(from: loc) &lt;= thresholdMeters\n        }.map { $0.0 }\n        \n        let tapped = closeDevices.first(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID })\n        let others = closeDevices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }\n            .sorted { $0.DeviceName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.DeviceName) == .orderedAscending }\n        \n        if let tapped {\n            return [tapped] + others\n        }\n        return others\n    }\n    \n    private func deviceCoordinate(for deviceID: String) -&gt; CLLocationCoordinate2D? {\n        if deviceID == self.deviceID {\n            if let animated = animatedDeviceLocation {\n                return animated\n            }\n            if let current = deviceLocation {\n                return current\n            }\n        }\n        if let cached = cache.getLocation(for: deviceID) {\n            return CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: cached.latitude, longitude: cached.longitude)\n        }\n        return nil\n    }\n    \n    private func computeNearbyGroups(from coords: [String: CLLocationCoordinate2D], thresholdMeters: Double = 35) -&gt; [String: [KnownDevice]] {\n        var result: [String: [KnownDevice]] = [:]",

        "contents": "    private func computeOffscreenDevicesByEdge(region: MKCoordinateRegion) -&gt; [Edge: [ArrowData]] {\n        var devicesByEdge: [Edge: [ArrowData]] = [:]\n        \n        // Current device\n        if let device = device, let coordinate = deviceLocation,\n           let edge = OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper.edge(\n                for: coordinate,\n                in: region,\n                screenSize: screenSize,\n                heading: currentMapCamera?.heading ?? 0\n            ) {\n            let tap = {\n                withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8)) {\n                    if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                        if let currentRegion = cameraPosition.region {\n                            cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentRegion.span))\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        self.region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: self.region.span)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n            let centerLocation = CLLocation(latitude: region.center.latitude, longitude: region.center.longitude)\n            let distanceKM = deviceLocation.distance(from: centerLocation) / 1000.0\n            devicesByEdge[edge, default: []].append(ArrowData(device: device, coordinate: coordinate, distanceKM: distanceKM, behavior: .jumpToLocation, onTap: tap))\n        }\n        \n        // Other devices\n        if settings.showOffscreenArrowsForOtherDevices {\n            let otherDevices = deviceStore.devices.filter { $0.DeviceID != deviceID }",

        "contents": "    ///   - deviceID: The ID of the device to fetch the visitor history for.\n    ///   - amount: The maximum number of visitor history entries to retrieve.\n    /// - Returns: An array of visitor data objects.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func getVisitorHistory(serverURL: URL,\n                                  forDeviceID deviceID: String,\n                                  amount: Int) async throws -&gt; [MiataruVisitor] {\n        \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/GetVisitorHistory\")\n\n        let requestBody = GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody(\n            MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload(Device: deviceID, Amount: String(amount))\n        )\n\n        let data: Data\n        do {\n            data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, encodablePayload: requestBody) {\n                \"[MiataruAPIClient] Requesting visitor history for device \\(deviceID) amount=\\(amount) payload=\\($0)\"\n            }\n        } catch APIError.encodingError(let err) {\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Encoding visitor history request failed for device \\(deviceID): \\(err.localizedDescription)\")\n            throw APIError.encodingError(err)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse.self, from: data)\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Received visitor history entries=\\(response.MiataruVisitors.count) for device \\(deviceID)\")\n            return response.MiataruVisitors\n        } catch {\n            if let jsonString = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) {\n                debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Visitor history decode failed for device \\(deviceID). Payload=\\(jsonString)\")\n            }\n            throw APIError.decodingError(error)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Fetches the visitor history for a specific device from the server, including server configuration.\n    /// This version automatically requests all available visitor history entries from the server.\n    ///\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - serverURL: The base URL of the Miataru server.",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse: Codable {\n    public let MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig\n    public let MiataruVisitors: [MiataruVisitor]\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruServerConfig\n        case MiataruVisitors\n    }\n\n    public init(MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig, MiataruVisitors: [MiataruVisitor]) {\n        self.MiataruServerConfig = MiataruServerConfig\n        self.MiataruVisitors = MiataruVisitors\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n\n        // Decode server config\n        MiataruServerConfig = try container.decode(MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig.self, forKey: .MiataruServerConfig)\n\n        // Decode visitors array with graceful handling of malformed entries\n        guard var visitorsContainer = try? container.nestedUnkeyedContainer(forKey: .MiataruVisitors) else {\n            MiataruVisitors = []\n            return\n        }\n\n        var parsedVisitors: [MiataruVisitor] = []\n        var index = 0\n\n        while !visitorsContainer.isAtEnd {\n            do {\n                let entry = try visitorsContainer.decode(MiataruVisitor.self)\n                parsedVisitors.append(entry)\n            } catch {\n                debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Skipping malformed visitor entry at index \\(index): \\(error)\")\n                _ = try? visitorsContainer.decode(SkipDecodable.self)\n            }\n            index += 1\n        }\n\n        self.MiataruVisitors = parsedVisitors\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct SkipDecodable: Decodable {\n    init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        ",

nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitor: Codable {\n    public let DeviceID: String\n    public let TimeStamp: String\n\n    /// Computed property for accessing the timestamp as a Date.\n    /// The timestamp from the API is in milliseconds, so we divide by 1000.\n    public var TimeStampDate: Date {\n        if let ts = Double(TimeStamp) {\n            // Timestamps from the API are in milliseconds, convert to seconds\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: ts / 1000.0)\n        } else {\n            return Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 0)\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Unique identifier combining DeviceID and TimeStamp for use in ForEach\n    public var uniqueID: String {\n        return \"\\(DeviceID)-\\(TimeStamp)\"\n    }\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case DeviceID\n        case TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(DeviceID: String, TimeStamp: String) {\n        self.DeviceID = DeviceID\n        self.TimeStamp = TimeStamp\n    }\n\n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        DeviceID = try container.decode(String.self, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        // TimeStamp can come as String or number\n        if let tsString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = tsString\n        } else if let tsInt = try? container.decode(Int64.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(tsInt)\n        } else if let tsDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .TimeStamp) {\n            TimeStamp = String(Int64(tsDouble))\n        } else {\n            TimeStamp = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n\n    public func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(DeviceID, forKey: .DeviceID)\n        try container.encode(TimeStamp, forKey: .TimeStamp)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Server configuration information from GetVisitorHistory response.\npublic struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String",

        "contents": "    private func pollVisitorHistory() async {\n        guard let targetId = targetDeviceId,\n              let url = URL(string: serverURL) else {\n            return\n        }\n        \n        do {\n            let visitors = try await MiataruAPIClient.getVisitorHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: ourDeviceId,\n                amount: 100  // Get enough entries to find recent visits\n            )\n            \n            await MainActor.run {\n                // Update cached history if it changed (compare by count and device IDs)\n                let hasChanged = visitors.count != cachedVisitorHistory.count ||\n                    !visitors.allSatisfy { visitor in\n                        cachedVisitorHistory.contains { $0.DeviceID == visitor.DeviceID &amp;&amp; $0.TimeStamp == visitor.TimeStamp }\n                    }\n                if hasChanged {\n                    cachedVisitorHistory = visitors\n                }\n                // Always re-evaluate mutual state based on current time, even if history hasn't changed.\n                // This ensures the state updates when the age of the last visit exceeds the exit threshold.\n                updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: targetId)\n                lastPollTime = Date()\n            }\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"[MutualNavigationDetector] Failed to fetch visitor history: \\(error)\")\n            // On error, still re-evaluate state based on cached data since time is passing\n            await MainActor.run {\n                if let targetId = targetDeviceId {\n                    updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: targetId)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    /// Update mutual navigation state based on visitor history and hysteresis logic.\n    private func updateMutualState(targetDeviceId: String) {\n        // Find the newest visitor entry for the target device",

If nil, requests the maximum available from server.\n    /// - Returns: The full response including server config and visitors.\n    /// - Throws: An &#96;APIError&#96; if the request fails.\n    public static func getVisitorHistoryWithConfig(serverURL: URL,\n                                                   forDeviceID deviceID: String,\n                                                   amount: Int?) async throws -&gt; MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse {\n        \n        let url = serverURL.appendingPathComponent(\"v1/GetVisitorHistory\")\n        \n        // First request with a reasonable default to get server config\n        let initialAmount = amount ?? 1000\n        let requestBody = GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody(\n            MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload(Device: deviceID, Amount: String(initialAmount))\n        )\n\n        let data: Data\n        do {\n            data = try await performPostRequest(url: url, encodablePayload: requestBody) {\n                \"[MiataruAPIClient] Requesting visitor history for device \\(deviceID) amount=\\(initialAmount) payload=\\($0)\"\n            }\n        } catch APIError.encodingError(let err) {\n            debugLog(\"[MiataruAPIClient] Encoding visitor history request failed for device \\(deviceID): \\(err.localizedDescription)\")\n            throw APIError.encodingError(err)\n        }\n\n        do {\n            let response = try jsonDecoder.decode(MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse.self, from: data)",

        "contents": "public struct MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig: Codable {\n    public let MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String\n    public let AvailableVisitorHistory: String\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory\n        case AvailableVisitorHistory\n    }\n\n    public init(MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory: String, AvailableVisitorHistory: String) {\n        self.MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory\n        self.AvailableVisitorHistory = AvailableVisitorHistory\n    }\n    \n    public init(from decoder: Decoder) throws {\n        let container = try decoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        \n        // MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory can come as String or number\n        if let maxString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = maxString\n        } else if let maxInt = try? container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = String(maxInt)\n        } else if let maxDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory) {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = String(Int(maxDouble))\n        } else {\n            MaximumNumberOfVisitorHistory = \"0\"\n        }\n        \n        // AvailableVisitorHistory can come as String or number\n        if let availString = try? container.decode(String.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = availString\n        } else if let availInt = try? container.decode(Int.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = String(availInt)\n        } else if let availDouble = try? container.decode(Double.self, forKey: .AvailableVisitorHistory) {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = String(Int(availDouble))\n        } else {\n            AvailableVisitorHistory = \"0\"\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// The structure of the response for a GetVisitorHistory request.\npublic struct MiataruGetVisitorHistoryResponse: Codable {\n    public let MiataruServerConfig: MiataruVisitorHistoryServerConfig",

        "contents": "      description: Visitor History is stored on the server with every request to the location or location history information of a device. There is a server-side setting that controls up to how many Visitors the server is storing in the Visitor History before it removes the oldest one.                   "lineNumber": 14109,
                  "content": "  \"plan\": \"# Implementation Plan: Periodic Location Updates\\n\\n## Overview\\n\\nCurrently, &amp;#96;LocationManager&amp;#96; only sends location updates to the server when the location changes significantly (based on distance/accuracy thresholds). This plan adds a time-based criteria: updates will also be sent periodically at a user-configurable interval (1-24 hours), even if the location hasn't changed. This ensures battery level and other metadata stay current on the server.\\n\\n## Architecture\\n\\nThe implementation will modify the location update decision logic in &amp;#96;LocationManager.swift&amp;#96; to check both:\\n1. **Location change criteria** (existing): Distance/accuracy thresholds\\n2. **Time-based criteria** (new): Time elapsed since last server update\\n\\n## Implementation Details\\n\\n### 1. Add Setting for Periodic Update Interval\\n\\n**File**: &amp;#96;miataru/SettingsManagers/App Settings/SettingsManager.swift&amp;#96;\\n\\n- Add new &amp;#96;@Published&amp;#96; property &amp;#96;periodicLocationUpdateIntervalHo [... omitted end of long line]"
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14727,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"            \\\"value\\\" : \\\"This option determines the sensitivity of how often location updates are sent to the server. It's a combination of how much distance and accuracy of the location has changed compared to the last update.\\\"\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 14817,
                  "content": "                  \"content\": \"            \\\"value\\\" : \\\"Cette option détermine la sensibilité de l’envoi des mises à jour de position au serveur. Elle combine le changement de distance et de précision par rapport à la dernière mise à jour.\\\"\","
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 15032,
                  "content": "The implementation ensures that location updates (including battery level and other metadata) are sent to the server periodically based on the user-configured interval, even when the device is stationary. The time-based check works alongside the existing distance/accuracy-based criteria, so updates are sent when either condition is met."
                },
                {
                  "lineNumber": 15821,
                  "content": "When \"Off\" is selected, the app only sends location updates when the location changes significantly (based on distance/accuracy thresholds), not based on time. The default remains 2 hours, but users can disable periodic updates by selecting \"Off\"."
                }

                  "lineNumber": 10836,
                  "content": "        \"contents\": \"- Bicycle transport mode was removed; existing values fall back to walking for directions and car icons where applicable.\\n\\n**For developers:**\\n- &amp;#96;SettingsManager&amp;#96; stores all preferences in &amp;#96;UserDefaults&amp;#96; and triggers side effects such as permission checks and auto‑refresh.\\n- &amp;#96;iPhone_SettingsView&amp;#96; binds directly to these properties and navigates to &amp;#96;iPhone_LocationStatusView&amp;#96; (now a page) or re-runs the onboarding flow via &amp;#96;AppState&amp;#96;.\\n- Defaults are registered from &amp;#96;Settings.bundle&amp;#96;, enabling control from the system Settings app. The manager observes low‑power state and scene phase for UI effect gating.\\n- Reverse geocoding threshold is user‑configurable (off/100 m/1 km/10 km; default 1 km) and applied centrally.\\n\\n## Location Status &amp;amp; Error Handling\\n**For users:**\\n- A dedicated status view shows permission state, last GPS and server updates, background activity, and a log of recent events.\\n- If a network  [... omitted end of long line]"

                {
                  "lineNumber": 10938,
                  "content": "            \"text\": \"- &amp;#96;DeviceLocationCacheStore&amp;#96; caches coordinates, manages a centralized reverse‑geocoding queue with a configurable distance threshold, and stores results in &amp;#96;Application Support&amp;#96;. Views consult the cache first before hitting the network and throttle UI updates to the configured map update interval.\","

A &amp;#96;RouteCacheStore&amp;#96; caches routes by device and transport, with distance‑based invalidation.\\n- Static map elements such as &amp;#96;MiataruMapMarker&amp;#96; and &amp;#96;DeviceNameLabel&amp;#96; are rasterized and cached with keys that include color scheme and display scale; renderers respect Dynamic Type and set &amp;#96;isOpaque=false&amp;#96; where appropriate.\\n\\n## Haptic Feedback and UI Enhancements\\n**For users:**\\n- Actions like successful refresh trigger subtle haptic feedback, pulsing accuracy circles show location precision, and shimmering indica [... omitted end of long line]"

        "contents": "import Foundation\n#if canImport(FoundationNetworking)\nimport FoundationNetworking\n#endif\n\n// MARK: - Local Logging Helper\n\n/// Lightweight logging helper for the Miataru client library.\n///\n/// The main application target defines its own &#96;debugLog&#96; function, but it\n/// isn't visible inside this Swift package module. To keep the recent history\n/// logging changes compiling while still emitting useful diagnostics during\n/// development, we provide a local implementation that simply prints the\n/// message in debug builds.\nprivate func debugLog(_ message: @autoclosure () -&gt; String) {\n#if DEBUG\n    print(message())\n#endif\n}\n\n/// Configuration part of the Miataru request.\npublic struct MiataruConfig: Codable {\n    let RequestMiataruDeviceID: String\n}\n\n/// Strongly typed request body for the GetLocationHistory endpoint.\nprivate struct GetLocationHistoryRequestBody: Encodable {\n    var MiataruConfig: MiataruConfig?\n    var MiataruGetLocationHistory: GetLocationHistoryPayload\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruConfig\n        case MiataruGetLocationHistory\n    }\n\n    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        if let config = MiataruConfig {\n            try container.encode(config, forKey: .MiataruConfig)\n        }\n        try container.encode(MiataruGetLocationHistory, forKey: .MiataruGetLocationHistory)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Strongly typed request body for the GetVisitorHistory endpoint.\nprivate struct GetVisitorHistoryRequestBody: Encodable {\n    var MiataruGetVisitorHistory: GetVisitorHistoryPayload\n\n    enum CodingKeys: String, CodingKey {\n        case MiataruGetVisitorHistory\n    }\n\n    func encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws {\n        var container = encoder.container(keyedBy: CodingKeys.self)\n        try container.encode(MiataruGetVisitorHistory, forKey: .MiataruGetVisitorHistory)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Payload for GetLocation request.\npublic struct GetLocationPayload: Codable {\n    public let Device: String",

        "contents": "        // Prefer cached history; do not navigate if cache is empty.\n        if let cachedHistory = DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.getHistory(for: device.DeviceID) {\n            if cachedHistory.isEmpty {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n            } else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    showHistoryView = true\n                }\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        guard let url = URL(string: settings.miataruServerURL), !device.DeviceID.isEmpty else {\n            await MainActor.run {\n                errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"server_or_deviceid_invalid\", comment: \"Error: Server or DeviceID invalid\"))\n            }\n            return\n        }\n\n        let requestingDeviceID = thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID\n        let requestID = requestingDeviceID.isEmpty ? nil : requestingDeviceID\n\n        do {\n            let data = try await MiataruAPIClient.getLocationHistory(\n                serverURL: url,\n                forDeviceID: device.DeviceID,\n                requestingDeviceID: requestID,\n                amount: 10000\n            )\n            let normalized = normalizeHistoryEntries(from: data)\n            let sorted = normalized.sorted { $0.TimestampDate &lt; $1.TimestampDate }\n\n            guard !sorted.isEmpty else {\n                await MainActor.run {\n                    errorOverlayManager.show(message: NSLocalizedString(\"history_no_data\", comment: \"No history available placeholder\"))\n                }\n                return\n            }\n\n            await MainActor.run {\n                DeviceHistoryCacheStore.shared.setHistory(sorted, for: device.DeviceID)\n                showHistoryView = true\n            }\n        } catch let apiError as MiataruAPIClient.APIError {\n            let message = mapHistoryAPIError(apiError)",

Implementation complete. Added distance calculation to the visitor history list, matching the devices list.

## Summary

Updated `VisitorHistoryRow` in `iPhone_VisitorHistoryView.swift` to display distance to each visitor device, matching the devices list.

**Changes made:**
1. Added distance calculation in `subtitleText`:
   - Gets the visitor's location from the cache
   - Gets the current device's location
   - Calculates distance using `CLLocation.distance(from:)`
   - Formats distance based on metric/imperial system (same logic as `DeviceRowView`)

2. Updated subtitle format:
   - Before: `"Last seen: [time] ([exactDateTime])"`
   - After: `"Last seen: [time] ([exactDateTime]) • Distance: [distance]"`

3. Handles missing location data:
   - If either location is unavailable, shows "Distance: unknown" (same as `DeviceRowView`)

The distance display uses the same formatting, units, and localization keys as the devices list for consistency. The visitor history list now shows the distance to each visitor device, just like the devices list.

= nil, speed: Double? = nil) {\n        if let idx = locations.firstIndex(where: { $0.deviceID == deviceID }) {\n            let existing = locations[idx]\n            let moved = existing.latitude != latitude || existing.longitude != longitude\n            let updated = CachedDeviceLocation(\n                deviceID: deviceID,\n                latitude: latitude,\n                longitude: longitude,\n                accuracy: accuracy,\n                timestamp: timestamp,\n                // Preserve previous placemark to avoid UI flicker; will be updated by geocoding\n                country: existing.country,\n                locality: existing.locality,\n                timeZone: existing.timeZone,\n                batteryLevel: batteryLevel,\n                altitude: altitude,\n                speed: speed ?? Die Implementierung sollte funktionieren: Da `cache` als `@ObservedObject` beobachtet wird, aktualisiert sich die Ansicht automatisch, wenn sich die Standorte ändern, und `distanceText()` wird mit den neuen Werten neu berechnet.

Zusammenfassung der Änderungen:

## Zusammenfassung

Die Distanz wird jetzt in einer eigenen Zeile angezeigt. Die Struktur der Visitor History Zeile ist jetzt:

1. **Gerätename** (headline)
2. **Last seen** mit Zeitzone und exaktem Datum/Zeit (caption)
3. **Distance** (caption) - neue separate Zeile
4. **Placemark** (caption)

Die Distanz wird automatisch aktualisiert, wenn sich die Standorte im Cache ändern, da `cache` als `@ObservedObject` beobachtet wird.

Die Implementierung verwendet die gleiche Formatierungslogik wie `DeviceRowView` für Konsistenz und unterstützt sowohl metrische als auch imperiale Einheiten.

+    /// Returns the distance text for the visitor row (separate line)
+    private func distanceText() -&gt; String {
+        let distanceLabel = NSLocalizedString("device_row_distance", comment: "Label for the distance to the device in the device list row")
+        
+        guard let visitorCached = cache.getLocation(for: visitor.DeviceID),
+              let myCached = cache.getLocation(for: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID) else {
+            let unknown = NSLocalizedString("device_row_unknown", comment: "Default value for unknown distance")
+            return "\(distanceLabel): \(unknown)"
+        }
+        
+        let visitorLoc = CLLocation(latitude: visitorCached.latitude, longitude: visitorCached.longitude)
+        let myLoc = CLLocation(latitude: myCached.latitude, longitude: myCached.longitude)
+        let distance = visitorLoc.distance(from: myLoc) // in meters
+        
+        let usesMetric: Bool
+        if #available(iOS 16.0, *) {
+            usesMetric = Locale.current.measurementSystem == .metric
+        } else {
+            usesMetric = Locale.current.usesMetricSystem
+        }
+        
+        let formattedDistance: String
+        if usesMetric {
+            let meterUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_meter_unit", comment: "Unit for meters in device row distance display")
+            let kilometerUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_kilometer_unit", comment: "Unit for kilometers in device row distance display")
+            if distance &lt; 1000 {
+                formattedDistance = String(format: "%.0f %@", distance, meterUnit)
+            } else {
+                formattedDistance = String(format: "%d %@", Int(round(distance / 1000)), kilometerUnit)
+            }
+        } else {
+            let feetUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_feet_unit", comment: "Unit for feet in device row distance display (imperial)")
+            let milesUnit = NSLocalizedString("device_row_miles_unit", comment: "Unit for miles in device row distance display (imperial)")
+            let distanceInFeet = distance / 0.3048
+            let distanceInMiles = distance / 1609.34
+            if distanceInFeet &gt; 528 { // More than 1/10 mile
+                formattedDistance = String(format: "%.2f %@", distanceInMiles, milesUnit)
+            } else {
+                formattedDistance = String(format: "%.0f %@", distanceInFeet, feetUnit)
+            }
+        }
+        
+        return "\(distanceLabel): \(formattedDistance)"
+    }
+

All changes have been committed. Summary:

## Changes Summary

**Main Feature: Distance Display in Visitor History**
- Added distance calculation and display to each visitor history row
- Distance is shown on its own line (separate from the "Last seen" subtitle)
- Uses the same distance calculation logic as `DeviceRowView` for consistency
- Supports both metric (meters/kilometers) and imperial (feet/miles) units based on user locale
- Distance updates automatically when device locations change (via `@ObservedObject` cache observation)
- Shows "unknown" when location data is unavailable

**UI Improvements:**
- Changed font size from `.caption` to `.caption2` for all subtitle/caption text (Last seen, Distance, Placemark) to make the display more compact

**Implementation Details:**
- Created new `distanceText()` function that calculates distance between visitor device and current device
- Distance calculation uses `CLLocation.distance(from:)` for accurate geographic distance
- Formatting matches the devices list for consistency across the app

The commit has been created on the `history` branch with commit hash `f2ab32e`.
